architecture rtl of mux2 is
begin
  -- when/else style:
  y1 <= a when sel = '0' else b;        -- line 4
  -- with/select style:
  with sel select
    y2 <= a when '0',
          b when others;                 -- line 8
end architecture;

note.en: Initial state. sel = 0; both concurrent statements will pick a.
note.es: Estado inicial. sel = 0; ambas sentencias concurrentes seleccionarán a.

note.en: Both concurrent statements fire in the SAME delta cycle — source order is irrelevant.
note.es: Ambas sentencias concurrentes se disparan en el MISMO ciclo delta — el orden del código es irrelevante.

note.en: Delta closes. y1 = a = 1 (when/else picked the true branch); y2 = a = 1 (with/select matched '0'). Same circuit, two syntaxes.
note.es: Cierra el delta. y1 = a = 1 (when/else tomó la rama verdadera); y2 = a = 1 (with/select coincidió con '0'). Mismo circuito, dos sintaxis.

note.en: sel flips to 1. Both concurrent statements wake again — they're implicitly sensitive to every signal they read.
note.es: sel cambia a 1. Ambas sentencias concurrentes se despiertan otra vez — son implícitamente sensibles a cada señal que leen.

note.en: Same parallel evaluation. The when/else's else-clause selects b; with/select's 'others' selects b.
note.es: Misma evaluación en paralelo. La cláusula else de when/else selecciona b; el 'others' de with/select selecciona b.

note.en: Delta closes. y1 = y2 = b = 0. The two syntaxes describe identical hardware.
note.es: Cierra el delta. y1 = y2 = b = 0. Las dos sintaxis describen hardware idéntico.
